g.text: 1. T2D is the richest indication: 211-281K D2+ HCPs per pool

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Cross-indication overlap is high (74-88%): same HCPs across T2D/CKD/HF

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. SGLT2/GLP1 and ACE/ARB prescribers overlap tightly (84-90% in T2D/CKD)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. sMRA is a more distinct population (54-69% cross-pool overlap)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. T1D is small and specialized (43-97K D2+, cross-pool overlap <= 46%)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Grand union of 458K HCPs is a plausible v4 universe candidate
